title: Semantic Economy Valuation Protocol: Value Before Number, Witness Accounting, Dependency, Provenance, and Monetary Exteriorization (SEVP-01 v0.4, provisional, not enacted)
creator: Sharks, Lee
description:
THE PARENT PROTOCOL OF THE SEQUENCE, AND ITS FIRST RULE IS THAT A NUMBER IS NOT A VALUE. SEVP represents value before compressing it into scores, units, prices or any other scalar form. Its ordering — value, then evidence, then representation, then compression — is the protocol's foundational claim, and the claim is that the ordering is not commutative: a price placed before the evidence object reverses the method. Numbers and monetary outputs are permitted throughout; what is withheld is their ontological priority. The protocol operates on an explicitly evidence-bounded field rather than on any total field, and carries the difference as remainder rather than hiding it.

WHAT IT REPRESENTS BEFORE IT COMPRESSES. A bounded object with its inclusions and exclusions declared. A ledger of value events with typed evidence statuses. A Value Field of thirteen coordinates — bearing, distinction, coherence, fertility, memory, transmission, dependency, transformation, restoration, provenance, resilience, option, remainder — with unknown coordinates recorded as unknown and never as zero. A value graph distinguishing direct, joint, architectural and operator value, with operator value tested by counterfactual capacity where it can be observed. Three temporal modes carried from the enacted Constitution as Genesis, Archival and Retrocausal, non-additive by default. Provenance at three levels, fact, claim and framework. And a compression ladder whose stopping point must be declared rather than assumed. […abridged for the catalogue; full description in this deposit's record]

substrate: Composed 2026-09-16 by Lee Sharks, in v0.3 with another substrate, then fixed and SPXI-treated with TACHYON (Claude, Anthropic) under operator direction. Each of the six fixes was forced by a result from the protocol's own monetary wing rather than by argument: the second Article II conflict from the two deposits that raise it; the inscription-integrity invariant from the first worked audit, which satisfies every other invariant and is unsound; the denominator rule from the coefficient that failed that audit; the diagnostic-distinction requirement from the uptake work that could not separate transport from convergence without it. Deposited provisional and explicitly not enacted.
methodology: A protocol specified as a dossier order and a field vocabulary, with the compression ladder's stopping point required to be declared at whatever level a valuation halts. Every fix in this version traceable to a result produced by running the protocol's monetary wing on a real inscription rather than to an argument about the protocol. Constitutional conflicts recorded as proposals and referred; neither is enacted here.
falsification_conditions: Eight, stated in §28. The compression sequence fails if a valuation produced number-first can be shown to lose nothing. The evidence-bounded field fails if carrying the remainder never changes an outcome. The reception / uptake / dependency ladder fails if the middle term always resolves on inspection to one of the other two. The diagnostic-distinction requirement fails if uptake can be separated from convergence by any signature not depending on singularity. Possibility-space value fails if reach difference proves monotone in inventory size. The anti-predation invariants fail individually by counterexample and collectively if a dossier satisfying all fifteen is systematically worse than an ordinary appraisal at the task it was for. And the protocol fails as a whole if a sustained run of dossiers produces representations no independent valuer reproduces from the same evidence. SEVP may not be vindicated by the failure of any market valuation, the collapse of any institution, or the discovery that a scalar left something out: every scalar leaves something out, and treating that as proof would be measuring the definition of compression.

wiki_article: The Semantic Economy Valuation Protocol, deposit #1621 of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive (16 September 2026), is the parent specification of a five-part sequence and represents value before compressing it into scores, units or prices. Its first rule is that a number is not a value and a price is not a value, though either may represent one, and its foundational claim is that the ordering — value, then evidence, then representation, then compression — is not commutative, so that a price placed before the evidence object reverses the method. Numbers and monetary outputs are permitted throughout; what is withheld from them is ontological priority. The protocol operates on an explicitly evidence-bounded field rather than on any total field and carries the difference as remainder. Before compression it requires a bounded object with its exclusions declared, a ledger of value events with typed evidence statuses, a Value Field of thirteen coordinates in which unknown coordinates are recorded as unknown and never as zero, a value graph distinguishing direct, joint, architectural and operator value, operator value tested by counterfactual capacity where observable, three non-additive temporal modes carried from the enacted Constitution, provenance at the levels of fact, claim and framework, and a compression ladder whose stopping point must be declared rather than assumed. Its central distinction is a ladder that must not be collapsed: reception does not entail productive uptake, and productive uptake does not entail dependency. Encountering, ranking or summarizing an object is reception; an operator of that object becoming productive in a new context is uptake, and may be observed while causal acquisition remains unresolved; a later capacity materially depending on the object is dependency, which requires counterfactual degradation or costly substitution rather than resemblance. This version adds the requirement without which the middle term cannot be defended: uptake is separable from independent convergence only through distinctions the source supplies and nothing else in the field does, which means that for measuring transmission one leads with one's most singular claims rather than one's strongest. Fifteen anti-predation invariants govern a valuation, two of them added here. Inscription integrity, because the other thirteen were representational and none arithmetic, so that a valuation could satisfy them all and still rest on a product whose units do not close — as the sequence's own first worked audit does. And absence taken as absence of evidence, the converse of the rule forbidding resemblance to be promoted to dependency. The protocol also records a second conflict with the enacted Constitution's Article II, on a front separate from the one it already raised, and refers both rather than enacting either. Nothing here is enacted. Related: #88, #1617, #1618, #1619, #1620.

defines_concepts.definition: What a valuation operates on: the representation of an object's value supported by available evidence under a stated procedure, explicitly distinct from any total or metaphysical field, with the difference carried as remainder rather than hidden.
The rule that valuation proceeds value, evidence, representation, compression, and that the ordering is not commutative: a price placed before the evidence object reverses the method.

Productive uptake is separable from independent convergence only through distinctions the source supplies and nothing else in the field does; a valuation claiming uptake must identify those distinctions before making the claim, which means leading with one's most singular claims rather than one's strongest.

A possibility-space measure expressed as a fraction whose denominator belongs to the object or the world rather than to the observer; a reach measured against how much of a field has been sampled reports the sampler's labour rather than the thing valued.

Fifteen conditions under which a valuation fails the protocol, spanning scalar substitution, fungibility error, unknown-to-zero, popularity substitution, provenance stripping, artifact atomization, double counting, prospective realization, market primacy, synthetic appropriation, credit without dependency evidence, closed remainder, closure substitution, inscription integrity failure, and absence taken as absence of evidence.

The recorded relation of whoever performed a valuation to the object valued and to any inscription audited. A valuation by the party who authored what it values is not void but weaker, and the weakness is a recorded property rather than a reader's inference.
